_help.dragLockRem: Touch: how far a finger moves before a press counts as a drag (sideways = spin, up/down = fast drop) instead of a tap or a hold. In rem (1 rem = 16 px today) so it feels the same on every phone.
_help.dragDeadZoneRem: Touch: how far sideways a drag goes before the tank starts spinning (hold past it to keep spinning, like a joystick). In rem (1 rem = 16 px today).
_help.flickMs: Touch: a quick flick up (console) or down (a short fast drop) must be over within this many ms, finger down to finger up.
_help.flickRem: Touch: how far up or down a quick flick must travel. In rem (1 rem = 16 px today).
_help.flickDropMs: Touch: how long a quick flick down fast-drops for (ms, on the rules clock — it stands still under a pause).
